derivation.occupation: Normalized orbit sum |n>=sqrt(prod n! / F!) sum distinct copy words. Sum_f |a><b|_f has coefficient sqrt(n_b(n_a+1)) for a!=b and n_b for a=b, times local16-mode CAR sign. derivation.Coulomb: HC=64 rho_total^T full64Lplus rho_total, with rho_total=active+sum63aux-initialRef4 including all filled spectators BEFORE squaring. Cross terms retained; no Wick.
derivation.electric: HE=64||sum incoming native path characters||^2 in all129 coordinates. Tree T depends aggregate rho; k=T rho+Cw. Every applied path shifts k by its exact directed unit column; integer cycle difference checked.
derivation.physical_units: Literal exp(iTheta)=exp(i a Aphysical), a1/64: Jphysical=aJTheta, contactphysical=a^2contactTheta. Probe f_e=exp(iq.site)/8 on y links. Both Jq/Jq† channels, no bounded fullPhi physical-current claim.
